key: pga tour golf (1991)(electronic arts)[cr agl]/PGA Tour Golf (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr AGL].adf:Golf:0:0000
name: run_callbacks_then_free_memory
description: Program entry that calls several unnamed routines, invokes a function pointer taken from a global table in a loop, clears a longword in memory, and then frees memory through the Amiga exec library.

key: pga tour golf (1991)(electronic arts)[cr agl]/PGA Tour Golf (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr AGL].adf:Golf:0:003C
name: decrement_word_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit register variable in a loop until it reaches minus one, then returns. Two unnamed routines call it.

key: pga tour golf (1991)(electronic arts)[cr agl]/PGA Tour Golf (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr AGL].adf:Golf:4:0000
name: decode_and_accumulate_values
description: Runs three passes that call a function pointer and an unnamed decoding routine to read values, then adds each value into a memory array at an index built from those reads. The pseudo-code shows no library calls, so the purpose of the stored data is not clear.

key: pga tour golf (1991)(electronic arts)[cr agl]/PGA Tour Golf (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr AGL].adf:Golf:4:005A
name: merge_zero_into_d0
description: Two-instruction stub that calls a routine merging zero into the D0 register. The long decoder listing attached to this entry does not match its two-instruction size, so only this short behaviour is supported.

key: pga tour golf (1991)(electronic arts)[cr agl]/PGA Tour Golf (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr AGL].adf:Golf:4:0060
name: unpack_stream_backwards
description: Decodes a bit-packed stream read from its end toward its start, using a bit buffer and length values from global data, and writes the decoded bytes downward from a destination pointer. Called by two unnamed routines.

key: pga tour golf (1991)(electronic arts)[cr agl]/PGA Tour Golf (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr AGL].adf:Golf:4:01D6
name: copy_decoded_byte_groups
description: Copies bytes in groups of four, reading backwards from the source and writing forward into the destination. When the count reaches zero it returns the first longword of the output, and it is entered by address from the decoder.

key: pga tour golf (1991)(electronic arts)[cr agl]/PGA Tour Golf (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr AGL].adf:l/Disk-Validator:0:0000
name: scan_bit_range_and_count
description: Writes a two-digit count as characters into a text buffer, fills an index table with minus-one entries, and loops over a bit range comparing bits from two table words while counting the positions that differ. It makes many unnamed calls through a function pointer.

name: lookup_table_word_by_index
description: Doubles the 16-bit input to form a byte offset, reads a 16-bit value from a fixed table in the program's data, and returns it packed with the shifted index.

name: set_flag_and_write_marker
description: Stores one in a 16-bit table entry indexed by the parameter and writes the byte value 94 into a pointer slot derived from the same parameter plus sixteen.

name: clear_flag_and_reset_marker
description: Stores zero in a 16-bit table entry indexed by the parameter and writes the byte value 32 into the paired pointer slot.

name: toggle_flag_and_branch
description: Flips the low bit of a byte in a table entry indexed by the parameter, calls an unnamed routine, and then calls one of two other unnamed routines depending on whether that result is zero.

name: call_single_routine_and_return
description: Makes one call to an unnamed routine and returns. Nothing else appears in the listing.

name: run_six_iteration_update_loop
description: After two tests through unnamed routines, passes a fixed table address and a count of twelve to a routine, then loops six times calling one of two routines according to a result.

name: conditionally_invoke_table_update
description: Checks a result from an unnamed routine and then calls a routine with a fixed table address and a count of twelve, making an extra call with the same address first when a second test succeeds.

name: call_fixed_table_update
description: Calls one unnamed routine with a fixed table address, a second table address and the count twelve, then returns.

name: set_or_clear_bitplane_pixel
description: Sets or clears one bit in each of four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, using a mask from a small table and the bits of a global value to decide whether each plane is set or cleared.

name: wait_while_status_bit_set
description: Loops while a status bit in a byte two bytes past the pointer is set, then returns.

name: program_blitter_row_loop
description: Writes the blitter's mask, modulo, pointer, control and size registers, then loops over rows calling unnamed routines to start each blit. Two routines are called per row.

name: draw_rect_if_ready
description: Returns zero when a state flag is set or the two stored counters differ. Otherwise it computes a byte offset from the width and height fields, makes two unnamed calls around a draw call with that offset and the rectangle size, and returns one.

name: draw_rect_if_counters_match
description: Returns whether two stored counters in a record match. When they do, it computes a byte offset from the width and height fields and makes the same call sequence as the draw routine that tests a state flag.

name: draw_rect_at_offset
description: Multiplies a width field by a second field to form a byte offset, makes two unnamed calls around a draw call using two base addresses plus that offset, and returns one.

name: call_routine_over_index_range
description: Loops over an inclusive range of indices and calls one unnamed routine for each index. The global flag test selects the same call in both branches, so it has no effect.

name: call_routine_over_row_span
description: Makes calls for a widening set of offsets from the start values up to a count, then calls an unnamed routine twice for each index in the start-to-end span.

name: iterate_rectangle_rows_calls
description: Walks rows between two fields of a record and calls unnamed routines with values derived from the record's fields on each row, then repeats two calls for every index in a second range.

name: call_routine_twice_per_index
description: Loops over an index up to a limit read from the stack frame and calls an unnamed routine twice for each index.

name: call_routine_for_offset_pairs
description: Loops from one to a count, calling an unnamed routine with the start value minus the index, with the end value plus the index, and twice with the start value.

name: reset_pointer_if_enabled
description: When a global flag is nonzero, calls an unnamed routine with a fixed address and the value stored at the pointer, then stores a different fixed address into that pointer.

name: query_and_store_value
description: Calls several unnamed routines to set up a small record and tests two results. When either result is below one it takes the failure path; otherwise it stores a computed value into the caller's pointer, branching on a global flag.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two unnamed routines one after the other and returns. Four unnamed routines reach it.

name: call_routine_then_second
description: Calls an unnamed routine and then a second routine located elsewhere in the program's code, then returns.

name: lookup_checked_and_compare
description: Looks up a value through an unnamed routine using a fixed selector, rejects the result when an optional check fails, then returns one if a computed value equals the third argument and zero otherwise.

name: lookup_handle_and_compare
description: Looks up a handle with a second fixed selector, computes a value from it with another unnamed routine, and returns one when that value equals the third argument and zero otherwise.

name: call_frame_arg_return_one
description: Calls an unnamed routine with an argument read from the frame, calls a second unnamed routine, and returns one.

name: call_frame_arg_return_zero
description: Calls an unnamed routine and passes a short value from the frame to a second routine, then returns zero.

name: call_frame_arg_ok_result
description: Calls two unnamed routines, passing a value read from the frame to the second, and returns one.

name: lookup_and_report_found
description: Looks up a handle with a fixed selector through an unnamed routine, calls one of two other routines depending on whether the handle is zero, and returns whether a handle was found.

name: copy_bytes_forward
description: Copies a block of bytes from the source to the destination one byte at a time, for the number of bytes given as the third argument.

name: toggle_state_against_parameter
description: Compares a global state value with the parameter. On a match it sets the state to one and returns zero; otherwise it sets the state to zero and returns two. The repeated comparisons are identical, so only the first and default branches are reachable.

name: reset_state_if_matched
description: Compares a global state value with a longword read from the table base. On a match it sets the state to zero and returns one; otherwise it sets the state to zero and returns two.

name: advance_state_if_matched
description: Compares a global state value with a longword read from the table base. On a match it sets the state to one and returns two; otherwise it sets the state to zero and returns two.

name: set_flag_from_state_match
description: Compares a global value with a longword read from the table base and sets the global to one when they are equal and zero otherwise. Returns three on a match and two otherwise.

name: clear_state_return_two
description: Sets a global state value to zero and returns two.

name: set_flag_if_zero
description: Stores one in a global flag when the argument is zero and zero otherwise.

name: swap_adjacent_bytes
description: Swaps each adjacent pair of bytes in a buffer, stepping two bytes at a time for the count given as the second argument.

name: reverse_bytes_in_quads
description: Reverses the byte order of each four-byte group in a buffer, for the number of groups given as the second argument.

name: toggle_flag_after_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine and then inverts the low bit of a global flag.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Stub that performs no work and returns immediately.

name: reset_global_and_run_sequence
description: Sets a global value to zero, then makes a fixed sequence of nine calls to unnamed routines, one of which is a second routine located elsewhere in the program's code.

name: call_routine_around_fixed_address
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then another routine with a fixed address argument, then the first routine again.

name: call_routine_around_second_address
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then another routine with a different fixed address argument, then the first routine again.

name: call_routine_with_fixed_address
description: Calls one unnamed routine passing a fixed address.

name: call_routine_with_other_address
description: Calls one unnamed routine passing a different fixed address.

name: set_global_with_routine_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine with the current global value and the low word of the argument, stores that word in the global, and calls another routine with the word repeated into both halves.

name: call_when_global_in_range
description: Checks whether a global value equals a value from the first argument and falls within a range bounded by the two arguments, and calls an unnamed routine with that value when the test passes.

name: call_routine_for_two_spans
description: Makes two calls to an unnamed routine, each passing the global value together with the low and high words of one of the two arguments.

name: call_routine_for_span_pair
description: Makes two calls to an unnamed routine, each passing the global value together with words taken from the two arguments.

name: classify_character_code
description: Classifies a character using a flag table and maps certain punctuation characters to numeric codes, updating a global flag for some of them and returning a code or zero. Calls two unnamed routines.

name: repeat_call_and_flush_flag
description: Calls an unnamed routine to get a count, calls another routine that many times with the argument, then calls a routine and clears a global flag when that flag is set.

name: call_with_global_then_store
description: Calls an unnamed routine with the current global value and the low word of the argument, then stores that word into the global.

name: emit_three_calls_with_global
description: Calls an unnamed routine to get a length, then makes three calls to another unnamed routine with the global value, a zero, the high word of the first argument plus six, and the length.

name: emit_calls_with_parity_offset
description: Gets a length from an unnamed routine, chooses an offset of zero or four from its low bit, and makes three calls to another routine with the global value and offset coordinates.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Passes both arguments to an unnamed routine and returns.

name: emit_call_with_parity_shift
description: Gets a length from an unnamed routine, shifts the first argument by a multiple of that length with an offset of zero or two depending on its low bit, and passes the result to another unnamed routine.

name: forward_call_either_branch
description: Passes two arguments to an unnamed routine whichever branch of a global flag test is taken, so both branches make the same call.

name: forward_frame_values_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine with a word and a longword read from the frame, then returns.

name: forward_call_both_branches
description: Passes two arguments to an unnamed routine on both branches of a flag test, so the flag has no effect on the call.

name: draw_clipped_nibble_pixels
description: Clips a rectangle to a 320 by 200 screen, then draws each packed byte as two pixels, high nibble then low nibble, by calling an unnamed routine for each pixel. A second branch applies a different test.

name: draw_nibble_pixels_in_rect
description: Walks a rectangle's rows and columns reading packed bytes and passes each high and low nibble to an unnamed routine. A second path is used when a flag is set.

name: draw_nibble_pixels_unclipped
description: Walks rows and columns of a rectangle, passing the high and low nibble of each packed byte to an unnamed routine without bounds clipping. A second, column-skewed path runs when a flag is set.

name: advance_packed_pointer_by_rows
description: Advances the source pointer across the rows of a rectangle, then draws nibble pixels for the remaining cells through an unnamed routine. The pseudo-code is partly truncated.

name: draw_nibble_pixels_skewed
description: Walks a packed source along a skewed grid, checking bounds on each cell, and draws a nibble-derived pixel through an unnamed routine when the cell lies inside the rectangle.

name: draw_nonzero_nibble_pixels
description: Walks a packed source over a rectangle and calls an unnamed routine for each nonzero nibble inside the bounds, taking the high nibble first and then the low nibble.

name: draw_nibble_pixels_offset
description: Walks a packed source over a skewed rectangle and passes each nonzero high and low nibble that lies inside the bounds to an unnamed routine.

name: draw_nibble_grid_then_store
description: Walks a grid of packed bytes, passing each high and low nibble to an unnamed routine, then stores a frame value into the global.

name: draw_nibble_rows_then_store
description: Walks rows of packed bytes, passing each high and low nibble to an unnamed routine, and stores a frame value into the global once all rows are done.

name: draw_nibble_pairs_until_done
description: Passes the high and low nibbles of each packed byte to an unnamed routine, advancing across columns and rows until the row counter reaches its limit, then stores a frame value in the global.

name: build_record_and_submit
description: Builds a record on the stack from fields of the argument, fills in fixed bytes and longwords, and submits it through unnamed routines, but only after a check on a field or a routine result.

name: build_stack_record_and_call
description: Fills a stack record with a word returned by an unnamed routine, fields copied from the argument and fixed bytes, then passes the record to another routine.

name: call_routine_with_record_fields
description: Passes the stack record, several fields from the argument, the global value and the constant 192 to an unnamed routine.

name: fill_four_values_from_routine
description: Calls an unnamed routine four times using the same word field of the argument and stores each returned longword into successive fields of the argument.

name: flush_four_pending_entries
description: For each of four stored entries that is nonzero, calls an unnamed routine with the entry and two coordinate words, then clears that entry.

name: call_routine_for_twelve_rows
description: Calls an unnamed routine twelve times, passing a base address that advances by forty bytes each time.

name: update_row_record_from_table
description: Looks up a value through an unnamed routine and a table, computes a row offset from two argument fields for forty-byte rows, and writes fields into the row record, with the global flag choosing the write path.

name: copy_record_compute_byte_width
description: Copies position and size fields from a source record into the current record, computes a width in bytes by dividing the x value by eight and rounding up when there is a remainder, and makes two unnamed calls.

name: set_default_rectangle_globals
description: Stores eight constant values into the global variable in sequence: 320, 8, 0, 0, 240, 55, 0 and 0. These look like a window or screen rectangle.

name: copy_globals_to_record_slot
description: Copies several global fields into a forty-byte record slot selected by the parameter, then calls an unnamed routine. Both branches of a test use the same global address.

name: store_record_into_slot
description: Copies fields from a record passed in the frame into a forty-byte slot selected by an index, then calls two unnamed routines with that slot.

name: process_slot_if_active
description: Calls an unnamed routine with the forty-byte slot address selected by the parameter, but only when a longword field of that slot is nonzero.

name: process_slot_then_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine with the forty-byte slot address when a longword field is nonzero, then makes one further call to another unnamed routine.

name: fill_scaled_index_table
description: Makes two unnamed calls, then fills a table of two hundred words with the global value times each index, and finally sets the global to one.

name: claim_sprite_channel_two
description: Attempts to claim sprite channel two through an unnamed routine. When the claim fails it shows the sprite-in-use error text, then sets the global to one and calls a routine with fixed coordinates for that channel.

name: release_sprite_channel_two
description: Releases sprite channel two: if the global flag is set it calls a routine with the channel number, then clears the flag.

name: claim_sprite_channel_three
description: Attempts to claim sprite channel three through an unnamed routine. When the claim fails it shows the sprite-in-use error text, then sets the global to one and calls a routine with fixed coordinates for that channel.

name: release_sprite_channel_three
description: Releases sprite channel three: if the global flag is set it calls a routine with the channel number, then clears the flag.

name: claim_sprite_channel_four
description: Attempts to claim sprite channel four through an unnamed routine. When the claim fails it shows the sprite-in-use error text, then sets the global to one and calls a routine with fixed coordinates for that channel.

name: release_sprite_channel_four
description: Releases sprite channel four: if the global flag is set it calls a routine with the channel number, then clears the flag.

name: call_routine_with_global_value
description: Passes the global value to an unnamed routine and returns.

name: run_conditional_calls_on_flag
description: Makes unnamed calls depending on whether the global value is nonzero: one call always, one more call and two further calls only when it is nonzero, and a final call every time.

name: decode_sixteen_nibble_words
description: Loops sixteen times over a table of words, splitting each word into three four-bit fields and passing them with the index and the global value to an unnamed routine.

name: copy_two_words_from_global
description: Copies two words from fixed offsets in a record referenced by the global value into the two destination pointers.

name: classify_record_code
description: Looks up a record through an unnamed routine and sets the global to a code when particular flag bits are set: one or two for two specific stored values, and the stored value itself when it is below a limit.

name: open_system_libraries
description: Sets up global values and calls unnamed routines to open the diskfont, dos, graphics and intuition libraries, checking each result for zero.

name: setup_double_buffered_bitplanes
description: Stores two buffer addresses in the global table, calls an unnamed routine with depth four, width 320 and height 200 for each buffer, and fills four bitplane pointers spaced 8000 bytes apart.

name: swap_display_buffers
description: Stores the current buffer pointer into a field, flips the buffer index between two values, and calls unnamed routines to make the other buffer current.

name: copy_fields_from_buffer_one
description: Sets the global to one, then copies a pointer chosen from the global table into several record fields and loads the global from the fields of the chosen pointer.

name: copy_fields_from_buffer_zero
description: Sets the global to zero, then copies a pointer chosen from the global table into several record fields and loads the global from the fields of the chosen pointer.

name: report_graphics_init_failure
description: Calls unnamed routines selected by bits of a global value and always makes a final call with a fixed address. The graphics display initialization error text is referenced here, so the final call likely reports that failure.

name: release_resources_by_flag_bits
description: Clears and handles flag bits in a global value, calling unnamed routines for each set bit and for each nonzero stored pointer, to release resources in turn.

name: store_constant_global_value
description: Stores a fixed constant in the global variable. The interrupt-enable register is listed for this routine, but the pseudo-code only writes the global.

name: copy_record_words_set_a
description: Copies six consecutive words from a twelve-byte table entry in the first table area, selected by the parameter, into the global variable one at a time.

name: copy_record_words_set_b
description: Copies six consecutive words from a twelve-byte table entry in the second table area, selected by the parameter, into the global variable one at a time.

name: set_global_sequence_fifteen
description: Stores zero, then fifteen, then four into the global variable, leaving four as its final value.

name: set_global_sequence_fourteen
description: Stores zero, then fourteen, then four into the global variable, leaving four as its final value.

name: call_by_flag_then_finish
description: Calls one of two unnamed routines depending on whether the global value is zero, then makes one more call to an unnamed routine.

name: return_global_value
description: Returns the 16-bit value of the global variable.

name: select_resource_address_and_clear
description: Picks one of two fixed addresses according to whether an unnamed routine returns one, then clears the global. The call that uses the chosen address never runs, because the global is cleared first.

name: run_pending_global_calls
description: Makes up to two calls to an unnamed routine, each only when the global value is nonzero, and clears the global after each call. The second call passes a fixed address.

name: allocate_or_report_memory_error
description: Requests a block through an unnamed routine and, when none is returned, reports a memory error with the block size. The error text says a byte block was not found.

name: call_global_function_pointer
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored in the global variable and returns whatever value is left in the result registers.

name: fill_masked_span_four_planes
description: Fills a horizontal span across four bitplanes, applying start and end word masks from small tables and writing the middle words in a loop with a pattern taken from the global value.

name: store_dma_control_constant
description: Stores a fixed constant in the global variable. The DMA control register is listed for this routine, but the pseudo-code only writes the global.

name: stub_no_decompiled_code
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this routine. The listing shows only that it is entered from an unreached gap and records no calls.

name: copy_defaults_and_set_size
description: Copies seventy-two longwords from a fixed table into the global area, then stores the values 319, 199, 320 and 200 as size fields and calls an unnamed routine.

name: store_selected_default_pointer
description: Chooses one of two fixed table addresses depending on whether the global is zero, then stores the longword found there into two fixed memory locations and calls an unnamed routine.

name: copy_default_longword_to_pointers
description: Copies a longword from a fixed address into the two destinations passed to it.

name: write_checker_pattern_words
description: Writes pairs of 16-bit checkerboard patterns (21845 and 43690) or the all-ones value 65535 into the global, selected by bits 0, 1, 16 and 17 of the argument.

name: call_when_global_in_span
description: Checks whether a global value falls within a span bounded by two arguments and calls an unnamed routine with the high word of the first argument when the test passes, with a second branch for the outside-span case.

name: build_linked_index_lists
description: Walks index chains stored in a table starting from the global value, copying chain entries into two stack arrays of twenty words each. The pseudo-code is long and partly truncated.

name: copy_index_chains_into_buffer
description: Calls an unnamed routine with two frame bytes, then walks the same index chains as its neighbouring routine and copies each chain's entries into a buffer.

name: flatten_chain_entries
description: Follows index chains from the global value, writing each visited entry into a buffer, then processes the collected entries in a second loop.

name: accumulate_chain_values
description: Follows index chains again, writing each entry and a computed value into two buffers, and loops until the chain is finished.

name: accumulate_table_counts
description: Adds a longword from a table into a second table entry for each index in the buffer, and writes the high word of each sum into an output buffer.

name: sort_buffer_words_ascending
description: Compares each buffer word with its neighbour and swaps them when they are out of order, repeating across the buffer as a single sorting pass.

name: shift_buffer_entries_down
description: Shifts entries of a word buffer down by one position in a loop, adjusts the counters that describe the buffer, and makes two unnamed calls.

name: step_index_chains_with_calls
description: Loops over the index chains from the global value, making unnamed calls for each step, and returns once the index passes the global value.

name: clear_chain_table_and_reset
description: Zeros a table of one hundred longwords starting at a fixed address, then sets the global to one and back to zero.

name: clear_final_quarter_words
description: Increments the argument, computes a pointer into a table from it, and zeroes the final quarter of the words, from the count minus a quarter up to the count.

name: fill_words_to_limit
description: Stores a fixed word value into consecutive words from the current pointer until the counter reaches the limit held in the frame.

name: call_sequence_of_sixteen_routines
description: Makes sixteen calls in sequence to unnamed routines and two fixed routines, one of which is an empty compiled routine that does nothing.

name: call_three_unnamed_routines
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this routine. The listing records only that it makes three calls to unnamed routines.

name: compute_even_byte_count
description: Divides the argument by eight to get a byte count, adds one when any of bits 16 to 18 are set, and rounds the result up to an even number.

name: allocate_plane_record
description: Allocates a block sized from a stored field, using four or five times that field depending on a flag, and stores the block pointer and derived offsets in the record.

name: free_plane_record
description: Frees the block held in a record through an unnamed routine, passing four or five times the argument depending on a flag, then clears the record's pointer and offset fields.

name: process_all_table_entries
description: Loops over one hundred and eighty forty-byte table entries, passing each entry's pointer and two of its words to an unnamed routine.

name: process_entry_range
description: Processes the forty-byte table entries whose indices lie between two values read from an index table, calling an unnamed routine for each one.

name: process_indexed_entry
description: Looks up a forty-byte table entry through an index table using the argument, then passes its pointer and two of its words to an unnamed routine.

name: clamp_minimum_and_call
description: Clamps the first argument to a minimum of sixteen, passes it with the second to an unnamed routine, calls another routine when that returns zero, and returns the result.

name: unpack_nibble_rows
description: Unpacks rows of nibble-packed data from the source into the destination, rounding the word count up when flag bits are set. The pseudo-code is partly truncated.

name: unpack_nibble_rows_three_buffers
description: Unpacks rows of nibble-packed data using three pointer buffers, rounding the word count up when flag bits are set. It is the second variant of the unpack routine.

name: call_external_entry_point
description: Calls a routine at a fixed address outside this segment and returns.

name: call_external_entry_wrapper
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns.

name: run_boot_setup_sequence
description: Sets up a global value, calls unnamed routines, runs a loop of nineteen calls, then calls the boot entry routine, which finds the dos library module at startup, and sets the global to one.

name: delegate_to_unnamed_routine
description: Makes one call to an unnamed routine and returns.

name: setup_eight_row_sequence
description: Sets the global to fifty-two, calls an unnamed routine with fixed arguments, makes eight calls to another unnamed routine across a table, then calls a fixed routine when the global is zero.

name: set_table_entry_to_one
description: Stores one in a word table entry chosen by the global value.

name: set_table_entry_to_two
description: Stores two in a word table entry chosen by the global value.

name: call_sequence_with_zero_args
description: Makes four calls to unnamed routines, passing zero arguments to the second call.

name: run_init_sequence_return_byte
description: Calls a series of unnamed and fixed routines, toggling the global between one and zero around them, then returns a byte combined with 244 by a bitwise OR. The listing warns of overlapping instructions, so part of it may be misdecoded.

name: advance_counter_with_parity_check
description: Increments a global counter and returns early when the new value is even and a second test on the counter passes. Otherwise it branches on the counter value and calls two unnamed routines.

name: round_high_words_three_times
description: Repeats three times: shifts the global right by sixteen bits and adds one when the resulting word's top bit is set.

name: stub_self_assignment
description: Assigns the global to itself three times, so it has no effect.

name: check_value_limits_and_reset
description: Tests a global value through an unnamed routine against two limits. Within the limits it zeroes the global; otherwise it calls a routine with the value twenty-three and resets several globals.

name: clear_global_value
description: Sets the global variable to zero and returns.

name: get_global_word_value
description: Returns the 16-bit global value.

name: update_twelve_byte_entry
description: When the global value is nonzero, makes an unnamed call, then selects a twelve-byte entry through another unnamed routine and writes its fields differently depending on whether the global equals one.

name: call_one_unnamed_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listing records only that it makes one call to an unnamed routine.

name: call_routine_with_stack_frame
description: Calls an unnamed routine, passing the argument and a pointer to the caller's stack frame.

name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listing records only that it makes two calls to unnamed routines.

name: format_signed_number_text
description: Converts a value read through a pointer into characters written backwards from a buffer using a digit table and a sign flag, then returns the pointer to the first character. Called by one unnamed routine.

name: write_digits_from_table
description: Writes the digits of a value backwards into a buffer by repeatedly taking a remainder through an unnamed routine and looking up each digit in a character table, tracking a sign flag.

name: format_string_with_arguments
description: Works through a format string, copying ordinary characters through an output routine supplied as an argument and expanding percent conversions from the argument list. It returns the count written, or minus one on failure, and keeps a 187-byte local buffer.

name: write_four_bytes_to_output
description: Writes the four bytes of the global variable to the DOS output handle by calling the Output and Write library wrappers, then makes a further call.

name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from the source to the destination byte by byte, including the terminator, and returns the destination pointer.

name: measure_zero_terminated_string
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string and returns the count, excluding the terminator.

name: convert_char_to_uppercase
description: Converts a lowercase letter to uppercase by subtracting 32 and returns other characters unchanged.

name: convert_char_to_lowercase
description: Converts an uppercase letter to lowercase by adding 32 and returns other characters unchanged.

name: stub_no_operation_return
description: Stub with an empty body that returns immediately. The listing records one call that the pseudo-code does not show, so only the empty body is described.

name: jump_through_unrecovered_table
description: Makes an indirect call through a jump table that the decompiler could not recover, then returns. The target is unknown from this listing.

name: call_two_routines_undecoded
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists. The listing records only that it makes two calls to unnamed routines and is called by two unnamed routines.

name: seek_or_record_io_error
description: Seeks in a DOS file through a wrapper. When the seek fails it stores the IoErr code from the wrapper in a record field and returns minus one; otherwise it seeks back to offset zero and returns the result.

name: rewind_dos_file
description: Seeks to the start of a DOS file through the seek wrapper, passing zero as both offset and origin, and returns.

name: claim_free_handle_slot
description: Searches a six-byte table of handle slots for an empty entry and returns an error code when none is free. Otherwise it writes through the dos library's Write wrapper and a library vector call. The listing refers to dos.library.

name: read_file_or_report_error
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists. The listing records calls to the DOS IoErr and Read wrappers, which suggests a file read that reports errors.

name: open_dos_library_or_alert
description: Zeros a large table of longwords, stores the register value and a global pointer, then opens the dos library with exec's OldOpenLibrary and reports a failure through exec's Alert. Exec's Supervisor call is also listed.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Stub with an empty body that returns immediately. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: allocate_cleared_buffer_record
description: Allocates a block with the cleared-memory flag through an unnamed routine, sized from a table entry, stores its address in the global record and initializes the record's fields. When allocation fails it calls a routine with zero arguments. Output is also called from here.

name: prepare_text_buffer_from_record
description: Chooses a source string from a record or a global pointer, computes a size from it and the argument, allocates a buffer through an unnamed routine and copies the text into it. Library vector calls return the status.

name: append_zero_terminated_string
description: Appends a zero-terminated string from the source to the end of the destination, copying up to a limit of 32766 characters and stopping at the terminator.

name: append_string_limited_count
description: Appends characters from the source to the end of the destination, up to the count given as the third argument, then writes the terminator.

name: copy_string_padded_to_count
description: Copies up to the given number of characters from the source, stopping at the terminator, then fills the rest of the destination with zero bytes.

name: multiply_longwords_to_64bit
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values taken from the input registers and returns the 64-bit product, built from 16-bit partial products.

name: lookup_window_icon_record
description: Opens icon.library through a library vector call, looks up the window's icon entry, and stores its pointer and a value into the first argument record. It returns early when any lookup fails. The listing refers to WINDOW and icon.library.

name: signed_divide_longwords
description: Performs a signed division by calling an unnamed unsigned routine and negating the result when the operand signs differ.

name: signed_remainder_adjust
description: Calls an unnamed unsigned routine and negates its result when the first operand is negative, then returns the result with the second operand.

name: forward_unsigned_routine_result
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns the value left in the result registers unchanged.

name: call_routine_discard_result
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns, leaving no result.

name: divide_longword_unsigned
description: Performs an unsigned division of a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor. It uses a bit-by-bit restoring loop when the divisor's high word is nonzero and a short division otherwise, returning quotient and remainder.

name: divide_longword_restoring_loop
description: Performs an unsigned restoring division of the two register operands using a sixteen-step bit loop, leaving the quotient and remainder in the registers.

name: forward_call_then_return
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns, with no other work.

name: call_two_routines_timeout
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists. The listing records only that it makes two calls to unnamed routines and is called by one unnamed routine.
